page_title: BIL 2-0 ATM | Athletic Bilbao v Atletico Madrid 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+5' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Nico Williams goes off the pitch and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
89' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
89' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
89' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
89' An attempted cross from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is cleared. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

88' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
88' Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
87' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
85' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao).
85' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Inaki Williams will be replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
85' It is time for a substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is on for Oihan Sancet.
84' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.

83' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Unai Simon guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
80' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:5.

80' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
79' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
77' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) replaces Benat Prados Diaz.
76' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
75' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it.
74' The game is interrupted now, Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

73' CHANCE! Inaki Williams finds Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
72' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
70' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
70' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
69' Half-chance! Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Unai Simon reacts well to snuff out the attack.
68' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

68' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom left corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Jan Oblak. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Alvaro Morata.
64' 2 - 0 Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Jan Oblak with a strike into the top left corner. He makes it 2:0.
62' Some great controlled play and passing from Atl. Madrid. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
60' The attendance for today's match is 48781.
60' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) replacing Saul Niguez.
59' Substitution. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Antoine Griezmann walks off.
58' The free kick is taken by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), but ball is cleared.

57' It looks like Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Jesus Gil Manzano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Ath Bilbao will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
55' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

51' 1 - 0 Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) meets a perfect cross from Ander Herrera deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
51' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee signals a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
51' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
50' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card!
48' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

48' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Atl. Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) comes on in place of Nahuel Molina.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) will replace Caglar Soyuncu.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick, but Unai Simon reads it well and stops the effort.

45+1' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sprays a pass out to Gorka Guruzeta, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

43' What a chance that is! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
40' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.

38' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
38' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner.
37' Atl. Madrid couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) leaped high and intercepted the cross. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
37' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
36' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) fails to score from the penalty kick. His shot goes just a few inches over the crossbar.
36' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
35' Caglar Soyuncu (Atl. Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Ath Bilbao!!
33' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon gets a hand to it and keeps it out.

32' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
32' Atl. Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
30' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
26' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Gil Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
24' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

23' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
23' That looked a certain handball by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
23' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Atl. Madrid get a corner.
22' Great chance! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
22' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Jan Oblak.
18' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

15' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon was ready and made a save.
15' Atl. Madrid take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
15' Poor challenge! Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Atl. Madrid.

13' The cross into the penalty area from Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

12' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
11' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Gil Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
9' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot to the top of the net, but the keeper denies him.
9' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

5' Jan Oblak pulls off a great save to deny Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
3' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) picks up a long through ball, but Jan Oblak deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Ath Bilbao will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jesus Gil Manzano.
